title: Tetrahexahedral
summary: TETRAHEXAHE'DRAL, adjective [Gr. four, and hexahedral.] In crystallography, exhibiting four ranges of faces, one above another, each range containing six faces.

inlines.v: TETRAHEXAHE'DRAL, adjective [Gr. four, and hexahedral.] In crystallography, exhibiting four ranges of faces, one above another, each range containing six faces.
